paragraphs.text: Omnath , also known as the "flickering heart", is a divine manifestation of the wild and chaotic mana of Zendikar , an elemental being that can be found in some incarnations of many creation myths of the plane.

Omnath is a being of pure mana , a manifestation of Zendikar's chaotic, primeval forces that is capable of wreaking massive destruction. It features in many of the plane's creation myths, and is considered the origin of the plane's mana. Omnath started as a pure green creature, but acquired other colors of mana one by one, incorporating red , blue , and white in that order. Finally, an outside influence gave it the power to harness black .

Despite the uncertainty of Omnath's actual existence, a real site on a high mesa in Ondu was dubbed the "Prison of Omnath". The site was safeguarded by a binding circle of strange globular swamp growths, stone hedrons , and animal bones. The circle created an eerie sensation in those who approached it, deterring them from approaching the circle's center, where a huge pit leads deep into the ground. Those who got too close were killed by the destructive surges of power that lashed out from the circle.

Religious pilgrims from across Zendikar traveled to the Prison of Omnath on a twice-yearly basis to perform the "Ritual of Lights", a ceremony designed to protect the world from the release of Omnath. During the events leading up to the Rise of the Eldrazi , however, the ritual was disrupted and Omnath was set loose. Like a human body fighting disease, Omnath began to adapt to deal with the Eldrazi threat. It absorbed more and more mana, embodying not just the might of the forests and jungles, but the fury of the mountains , the unrelenting seas, and the life-giving plains of Zendikar.

Ultimately, Omnath was compleated as part of the New Phyrexian Invasion , gaining access to their corrupted black mana . It is currently unknown what happened to Omnath after the phasing-out of New Phyrexia .

In the Echoverse , Omnath was a haunting colorless elemental of the void, embodying a voracious emptiness that consumed all the mana around it. The Kor Empire vainly thought that they could trap the elemental in a Skyclave prison, hoping to seal it away forever. But no prison was strong enough to hold the void. After a century of imprisonment, Omnath ate through the last of its bindings and freely roamed the plane once more. The elemental grows stronger with every leyline conduit it disrupted along the hedron network, draining life and mana from the world around it.
